data.value:
SRP (Philippine / typical market base price): Approx. ₱1,998,000 – ₱3,330,000 (Varies by trim, engine, and configuration)
SPECS:
Overall Dimensions (mm): 4,830 × 1,900 × 1,720–1,780 (Height varies slightly by variant) Wheelbase (mm): 2,815 Seating Capacity: 6–7 (depending on configuration)
ENGINE / PERFORMANCE
Engine Options:
2.5 L 4-Cylinder Gasoline (Smartstream)
Maximum Output: ~191 hp Maximum Torque: ~246 Nm
2.5 L 4-Cylinder Turbocharged Gasoline (higher trims)
Maximum Output: ~277 hp Maximum Torque: ~422 Nm
1.6 L Turbocharged Gasoline + Electric Motor (Hybrid variant)
Combined Output: ~232 hp Combined Torque: ~367 Nm
Transmission: 8-speed Automatic (2.5L NA) 8-speed Dual-Clutch Automatic (2.5T) 6-speed Automatic (Hybrid)
Drivetrain: Front-Wheel Drive (FWD) or All-Wheel Drive (AWD, depending on variant)
CAPACITY & CAPABILITIES
Towing Capacity: Not officially rated; suitable for light towing depending on configuration
Payload Capacity: Approx. 500–600 kg
Fuel Tank Capacity: Approx. 67 L (gasoline), slightly lower for hybrid
INTERIOR / CABIN / SPACE
Seating: 6–7 (three-row SUV)
Infotainment: Large panoramic touchscreen setup (12” class, depending on trim), Apple CarPlay / Android Auto
Speakers: 6–12 (premium audio on higher trims)
CHASSIS / BRAKES / WHEELS / SUSPENSION
Front Brake / Rear Brake: Ventilated Disc / Disc
Suspension: MacPherson Strut front, Multi-Link rear
Tires / Wheels: 18”, 20”, or 21” Alloy Wheels (depending on variant)
